text:
Artturi Lehkonen has 13 goals in 19 games, a pace that has people asking whether he's pricing himself out of Colorado. He's earned the question. He gets to the net (Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 90th percentile for chances from the slot) and he's had 7.9 expected goals, a strong total.

But 13 goals on 7.9 is shooting 31%, against 14% last season, and Colorado has scored nearly 11 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Both numbers will come back toward earth. Evolving-Hockey also noted last season that he played with the strongest teammates in the league by their impact, which flatters any winger on MacKinnon's side of the roster.

None of that makes him a passenger. He's a Cup winner who does the hard things, with a habit of setting up from behind the net (27% of his setups, against 8% for a typical forward). Our range has him finishing at 27 to 42 goals.
